about.heroSubtitle: From Malang. For Indonesia. Celebrating Authenticity Through Versatile Lifestyle.
about.storyP1: Arianation started in Malang in 2010 when our father decided to celebrate supporter culture through custom t-shirt printing. What began as a simple passion for football culture evolved into something much more than just merchandise.
about.storyP2: Over the years, Arianation has been part of the Indonesian supporter journey, witnessing moments of pride and challenges. We learned that a brand is not just about products—it is about stories, community, and identity.
about.storyP3: In 2026, we start a new chapter. Not to abandon our roots, but to celebrate them while growing into something broader. We reposition Arianation as a versatile, authentic lifestyle brand rooted in true Indonesian passion.
about.phil1Desc: One piece, many uses. Arianation t-shirts can be worn for watching football, hiking, working, or casual hangouts. Like Stone Island, we believe in timeless quality and design for various contexts.
about.phil2Desc: Every product has a story. From supporter passion, local artists, to regional culture across Indonesia. We do not erase our supporter roots—we celebrate them as an authentic part of Indonesian identity.
about.phil3Desc: It is not about maximum profit, but building community. Limited drops, transparent pricing, meaningful collaborations—all to celebrate passion and culture together.
about.phil4Desc: Materials that respect durability across activities. Thoughtful design. Ethical production. We believe in quality that speaks for itself.
about.visionP1: We want Arianation to be known from Sabang to Merauke as a lifestyle brand that celebrates authentic Indonesian passion and culture.
about.visionP2: Not a brand that copies trends, but a brand that sets trends through authenticity, quality, and community.
about.visionP3: We are building a movement to recognize that Indonesian culture—from supporter passion, local artists, to regional tribes—deserves to be celebrated with respect and quality.
about.ctaDesc: Arianation is more than a brand. It is a celebration of authentic Indonesian lifestyle, passion, and culture. Be part of our journey.

faq.title: FAQ & Help Center
faq.desc: Help center and frequently asked questions regarding services, shipping, payments, and warranties at Arianation.
faq.heading: Help Center
faq.subheading: Answers to common questions about Arianation. If you do not find the answer you are looking for, please contact our team.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: We offer standard shipping of 3-5 business days across Indonesia. Express shipping is available for the Jakarta area in 1-2 business days for an additional fee.

faqs.question: Can I request a custom design?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide custom screen printing services with designs tailored to your preferences. Contact our support team for a free consultation and quote.

faqs.question: What is the return process?
faqs.answer: Products can be returned within 14 days if there is a manufacturing defect or the order is incorrect. Contact our customer service with your proof of purchase for a refund process.

faqs.question: Is there a quality guarantee?
faqs.answer: All our products are 100% guaranteed original with premium quality standards. We provide warranties for stitching and color durability.

faqs.question: What payment methods are available?
faqs.answer: We accept bank transfers, credit cards, e-wallets (OVO, Dana, GoPay), and 0% installments through partner banks. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

faqs.question: Are there discounts for bulk purchases?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for wholesale or community bulk purchases. Contact our sales team for special rates.
